contract.title: SOC Dashboard Visual Parity - Rework 14
acceptance_criteria: Only Rework 14 is executable and only the exact four allowed paths may change; all other product, test, backend, provider, routing and runtime paths remain unchanged.

Remove the obsolete --sidebar-width 270px variable and the later unscoped global .sidebar rule from frontend/src/styles/global.css because repository search proves no other active source consumes that variable.
Keep the canonical Platform Sidebar width and min-width at 164px in Sidebar.css and keep the PlatformLayout first Grid track at 164px without changing PlatformLayout.tsx.
Do not use important declarations, selector escalation, negative margins, transforms, offsets or page-specific compensation and do not redesign the Sidebar.
Read both Sidebar.css and global.css in regression coverage and assert the canonical 164px width and min-width while rejecting any unscoped later 270px or variable-driven Sidebar width override.
A deliberately supplied later .sidebar width 270px or .sidebar width var(--sidebar-width) fixture fails the same cascade-contract predicate used for the valid production sources.
The PlatformLayout contract regression continues to prove gridTemplateColumns 164px minmax(0, 1fr) and connects that Grid value to the canonical Sidebar stylesheet evidence.
Tests describe source or deterministic CSS-contract evidence truthfully and do not claim jsdom performs native CSS cascade or browser pixel layout.
No changes occur in PlatformLayout.tsx, SOCLayout.tsx, ExplainabilityPage.tsx, ExplainabilityWorkspace.tsx, ExecutiveLayout.tsx, WorkspaceOutlet.tsx or any Dashboard and routing component.

Rework 13 evidence, WorkspaceSwitcher discoverability, the real SOC to Executive to SOC integration test, Executive 24px inset, Main scroll ownership and the complete Rework 10 visual, routing, truthful-data and UTF-8 contract remain passing.
Focused Sidebar cascade and PlatformLayout tests, existing cross-workspace, SOC Dashboard, Explainability and Executive regressions and the full frontend regression pass.
TypeScript, production build and git diff --check pass and Scope Guard confirms only the exact four authorized paths changed.
The immutable visual reference remains unchanged with SHA-256 af672a97050c5e535199d8d006012cf000e5e7b9b66693a02817c4356eea80df.

Product Owner Live Acceptance remains mandatory at 1536 x 1024 and 100 percent zoom for /, /explainability, /executive and return to / using real bundled CSS; verify computed Sidebar width 164px and exact Sidebar-right to Main-left adjacency.
Do not claim Product Owner PASS, transition TASK-0122 to DONE or create TASK-0123.
